intuition: The next level can be linked while traversing the current level through its already-established next pointers.

brute_force.approach: Run breadth-first search with a queue and connect adjacent nodes in each level.

optimal.approach: Use a dummy head and tail to stitch each next level in one pass, reusing the current level's next chain.

edge_cases: The tree may be sparse and need not be perfect.
The final node on every level must point to None.
